findings.source: Blind: Я жевал правду, давился ею, пока нёбо не сомкнулось у меня в горле.
findings.currentTarget: Blind: Nilitafuna ukweli, nikausonga koo hadi kaakaa likafunga koo langu.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Blind: Nilitafuna ukweli, nikasongwa nao hadi kaakaa likafunga koo langu.
findings.objectiveReason: давился ею means he choked on the truth, not that he strangled the truth/throat. Nikausonga koo changes both agency and object.

findings.source: Blind: Пальцы мои сжались до боли, когда я скользнул взглядом по ЭТОМУ.
findings.currentTarget: Blind: Vidole vyangu vilikaza hadi kuuma nilipoitazama HICHO.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Blind: Vidole vyangu vilikaza hadi kuuma nilipokitazama HICHO.
findings.objectiveReason: The unknown entity is consistently kiumbe/class 7 here, including emphatic HICHO. Class 9 nilipo-i-tazama conflicts with that exact same entity; nilipo-ki-tazama preserves the reference.
